instruction: When I watch videos in fullscreen mode on VLC, the control bar that appears at the bottom is distracting. Can you disable the fullscreen controller interface?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling VLC's fullscreen controller interface. The evaluator checks if the 'qt-fs-controller' setting in VLC configuration is set to 0 (disabled). This is similar to the original task which modifies VLC settings.
